name: Talking To A Brick Wall
look: A still from a video of a young man in a black T-shirt standing face to face with a red brick wall, gesturing with both hands, which are blurred with motion, as if explaining something passionately to the wall.
use: Explaining something to someone who won't listen or respond. The man is labeled as the one explaining, and the brick wall is labeled as the person or thing ignoring every word.
slots: who isn't listening (the brick wall, left)
examples: Me explaining that the vacuum is not a monster
Me trying to pick a time that works for everyone
describe: guy gesturing and lecturing a brick wall
dude explaining something to a red brick wall
person gesturing at a wall like it can hear him
talking and nobody listening brick wall video
